skill.keys.readabilityNote: 3px micro-labels fit the only non-overlapping gap in the supplied coordinate bands.

notes.coordinateOrigin: bottom-center GUI px; x right+, y up+
notes.ascentFormula: For target bottom-origin top Y: ascent = Y - 65. Vanilla actionbar drawString baseline gives text top at screenHeight-72; BitmapProvider ink top = drawY + (7-ascent).
notes.actionbarOrigin: centered; append -sum(advances) space to place cursor at x=0
notes.bitmapAdvance: 1.21.11 rounded ink width + 1; emitted advance = rightmost nontransparent pixel + 1
notes.contextualOverlayCaveat: Coordinates assume default/no contextual left-right GUI overlays; vanilla actionbar y shifts when those overlays occupy more height.
